name: 4-digit display (TM1637)
author: Bench Workshop
description: The red 4-digit 7-segment display with a colon (a clock display) on a TM1637 chip: two wires, CLK and DIO. Includes TM1637Display.h. The part decodes the real TM1637 signals bit by bit.

parts.name: 4-digit display (TM1637)
parts.description: CLK and DIO to any two pins, VCC (3.3-5 V), GND. TM1637Display display(CLK, DIO); display.setBrightness(5); display.showNumberDec(1234); The colon is the top bit of the second digit (showNumberDecEx(1234, 0b01000000)).

examples.name: Counting clock
examples.description: A TM1637 showing minutes and seconds since the start, with the colon blinking.
